description:
## Saiyan007 1.1.0

A Morphe patch for **Shima: Dynamic Island** (`com.piyush.island`).

- Unlocks Pro features.
- Automatically includes the Google Play installer-source fix.
- Targets any Shima version with matching bytecode.

Download **Saiyan007-1.1.0.mpp**, load it in Morphe, and select **Saiyan007** when
patching your original Shima APK or XAPK.

Build, patch application, APK signature, and bytecode checks passed on Shima
**0.4.0 (version code 7)**. Other versions and the rebuilt APK's on-device behavior
have not been verified.

Source code and Windows build instructions are included in the repository.

### SHA-256

```text
C0BAFF4EE099A1C88B61E0F093C70FFE2F0E2860BB991B543158D1B4B82D089F  Saiyan007-1.1.0.mpp
```

patches.name: Saiyan007
patches.description: Unlock Shima Pro features and report Google Play as the installer source.
